Lower values make CarPlay icons and text larger. Adjust from 100 to 400 mm in 50 mm steps. Applying a change reconnects CarPlay; video resolution stays the same.
Appearance, CarPlay size, resolution and browser frame rate
Direct H.264 video and low-latency playback. 30 fps is recommended; 60 fps is optional for smoother motion. Frame rate and CarPlay size changes apply after reconnecting.
